slice.boundary: Last inventory record; no following row exists.

review.method: Independent source comparison with all final 73 records, preceding rows 717-720, and menu help rows 325-340 (93 examined for a 73-row slice). Stats, own/enemy subjects, irreversible-operation direction and Match N fragment ordering reviewed; all positioning controls and newline counts checked.
uncertainties: Long stat labels precede @x200 positioning and may overlap values; real glyph widths and screen layout remain untested.
Own Unit durability labels correspond to hit points in the paired conditional help; no separate armor statistic is inferred.
review.composition_method: Read-only SH4 caller inspection confirmed direct native source pointers, Match prefix-number-suffix order, step-count suffix separation, and ten duration/clock unit draws. One necessary leading-space correction applied after independent meaning review.

native_field_types.step_count: 32-bit integer at 0x8c34f844; numeric mode -1.0 adds no separator
native_field_types.timer_units: Direct source-bank pointers: base 0x8c14cca8 plus offsets 19/24/86; no RAM copying in verified paths
native_field_types.equipment_type_tables: 32-bit pointers to exact source row starts; alternate right-aligned renderer 0x6460

source_storage: Source text remains on the original disc; bind by inventory ID and SHA-256. Global order is 560 menu messages followed by other game records sorted by file offset.

notes.721: Enemy State is distinct from Own State in preceding context row 720.
notes.724: Source durability corresponds to hit points in the matching conditional chip help. Own identifies your Marionette rather than an enemy.
notes.730: Counter number selects the counter; Count is its configured count, not the amount of counters.
notes.731: Clock Number selects a stopwatch ID for this chip; Stopwatch Number distinguishes it from the wall clock.
notes.733: Branch Time is the threshold used by the stopwatch branch; exact parameter view remains untested.
notes.736: The source marks a used/in-use label. Square brackets retain its status decoration in ASCII.
notes.737: Destination is the jump target of Skip/Call chips, confirmed by menu help rows 502-505.
notes.740: All @x200 controls are preserved exactly and in order. CPU/P-Card clock rate and capacity labels must fit before dynamic values; actual screen positions remain untested.
notes.747: Match-number composition originally has an ordinal prefix at row 747 and a Match suffix at row 748. Move the English Match label into the prefix and keep trailing space before the live number.
notes.748: Intentionally empty suffix: the Match label moved to row 747 so the native prefix + live number + suffix renders Match N, without duplicated wording. Empty does not indicate a missing translation.
notes.749: Elapsed Time refers to the result duration, distinct from stopwatch branch thresholds.
notes.751: Lowercase steps is a unit following a live count, distinct from the Step Count heading. Native caller 0x3453e prints the integer with mode -1.0, then 0x3454a draws this suffix without inserting a separator. Its leading space is required.
notes.755: Rows 755-758 are prioritized-action control patterns; focused retains the emphasis without claiming actions are exclusive.
notes.760: Medium is the explicit source adjective; equipment help elsewhere calls a brake type Intermediate. Do not silently invent consistency without checking the actual equipment type.
notes.763: Light/Heat retains both terms of this compound category without narrowing it to visible light, fire, or a laser weapon.
notes.765: Electrical/Thermal retains both terms of this compound category; do not conflate it with Light/Heat.
notes.766: Super-electromagnetic retains the source category modifier without inventing an acronym.
notes.771: Each processing category is retained in full. Long labels may overlap values after @x200; review layout rather than truncating meanings.
notes.773: Electrical Capacity and Combustion Efficiency are distinct hybrid-battery stats, confirmed by menu battery help row 326.
notes.775: Maximum Output and Maximum Energy Consumption are separate maximum stats; all source newlines and @x200 controls are preserved, including two-line value placements.
notes.777: Rebound Force and Damping Force are separate damper properties, confirmed by menu row 330.
notes.781: Compatible Types and impact/heat/electromagnetic resistance are separate stats. All controls and blank lines remain; long labels require layout validation.
notes.785: Deceleration Factor preserves the source coefficient meaning; do not confuse it with braking force at row 779.
notes.786: Reinforcement is irreversible; subject omission restored with an operation-specific warning.
notes.787: Weight reduction is irreversible; subject omission restored with an operation-specific warning.
notes.789: Duration-hour suffix uses neutral hr with leading and trailing spaces for live numbers and the next minutes readout.
notes.790: Shared minute suffix uses neutral min with leading space; no singular/plural inference. Five direct native draws verify the common suffix after live minute values in duration and alarm paths.
notes.793: Clock-hour suffix uses neutral h with leading and trailing spaces. Do not add AM/PM or change hour units to a colon without checking all native callers.
